title: Who Is Your Manager
description: A middle-aged Black woman in an orange uniform covered in text stands angrily pointing her finger upward. Her uniform bears a name tag reading "YOUR MANAGER?" while the surreal background features floating letters spelling "EVOLVE", clocks, flowers, and ghostly figures on a teal ledge.
prompt: A furious middle-aged Black woman wearing a bright orange uniform covered in repeating black text stands in the foreground pointing her index finger upward. Her name tag reads "YOUR MANAGER?". She has an angry expression with furrowed brows. Behind her is a surreal chaotic scene with large floating letters spelling EVOLVE, clocks, yellow and purple flowers, ghostly white figures, and papers on a teal shelf against a textured earthy background.
